result.topic_en: A draft letter to the Göttingen university printer asking for copies of the dissertation proof sheets, followed by draft passages for the dissertation's closing section on why the paper does not develop the theory of the analytic expression of functions or prove that its function concept coincides with dependence expressible by magnitude operations.

items.english: For the same reason we do not go into the proof here that the concept of a function used as the basis here coincides completely with that of a dependence expressible by magnitude operations.

items.english: We refrain for now from carrying out this theory, which, as remarked, is meant to bring to light simple laws of dependence determined by magnitude operations, since we presently exclude consideration of the expression of a function.
